taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-09 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 975.4 | 1.86 | 1.86
2 | 552.4 | 22.73 | 24.59
3 | 730.5 | 1.22 | 25.81
4 | 1710.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-09
Curve type: HA-type (ρ1 > ρ2 < ρ3 < ρ4 — note: this contradicts the on-file AA-type classification; re-verification of the digitized curve/file labeling is recommended)
Aquifer depth: 1.86 m – 24.59 m (Layer 2, 552.4 ohm-m)
Recommendation: Target drilling and screen placement within the 1.86–24.59 m interval, which corresponds to the lower-resistivity layer bounded by higher-resistivity units above and below — consistent with a saturated, permeable horizon. Case off the shallow top layer (0–1.86 m) during drilling to prevent collapse/contamination, and confirm lithology with cuttings/logging at the Layer 2–3 boundary (~24.6 m) before finalizing screen depth.
